games.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops — Zombies
games.desc: The iconic survival mode that defined a generation. Fight off relentless waves of the undead, board up barricades, rack up points, and unlock mystery box weapons.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to aim • Left Click to shoot • R to reload • F to rebuild/buy • Space to jump • Shift to sprint
games.goodToKnow: Click inside the window to lock mouse pointer (Press ESC to release). Sound initializes upon first interaction.

games.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops — Moon
games.desc: Blast off to Area 51 and the lunar surface in this standalone recreation of the Moon survival map. Experience low-gravity jumping, decompression zones, and the iconic biodome.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to aim • Left Click to fire • Space for low-gravity leaps • F to interact/buy weapons
games.goodToKnow: Remember to equip your P.E.S. spacesuit helmet when venturing outside onto the lunar surface to avoid asphyxiation!

games.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops — Kino der Toten
games.desc: The greatest Zombies launch map in history. Navigate the abandoned Berlin theater, turn on the power switch, link the teleporter to the projection booth, and Pack-a-Punch your arsenal.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to aim • Left Click to shoot • R to reload • F to activate power/doors • 1-3 to switch weapons
games.goodToKnow: Turn on the power in the main auditorium to activate traps and link the teleporter for instant Pack-a-Punch access.

games.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops III — Cheese Cube Unlimited
games.desc: The most famous custom challenge map ever built for Call of Duty Zombies. Scale an absurd multi-tiered cheese monolith, buying weapons and dodging tight corner ambushes.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to look • Space to jump • Shift to sprint • F to open barricades and buy wall weapons
games.goodToKnow: Higher floors get increasingly narrow and dangerous. Initial asset decompression takes a few seconds on first launch.

games.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II (Vibe Slops II)
games.desc: A full browser-based multiplayer build of Call of Duty: Black Ops II. Pick your loadout, hop into live lobbies, and dominate classic maps with authentic gunplay and movement.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to look & shoot • Right Click to ADS • C to crouch • Space to jump • Tab for scoreboard
games.goodToKnow: Features multiplayer networking. Pick a username and join an active server lobby or host your own.

games.title: Counter-Strike Surf (Surfd.net)
games.desc: Pure Counter-Strike surfing physics replicated flawlessly in the browser. Glide along steep ramps at terminal velocity, master air strafing, and race against the clock.
games.controls: WASD & Strafe (A & D) • Smooth Mouse Sweeps • Space to jump • R to restart ramp • Tab for timer leaderboard
games.goodToKnow: Never hold W while surfing! Hold A when on the right side of a ramp, and D when on the left side. Steer gently with mouse.

games.title: Halo: Combat Evolved (Web Port)
games.desc: Mitchell Hynes’s remarkable browser adaptation of Master Chief’s debut. Board the Pillar of Autumn, wield the legendary M6D pistol and assault rifle, and combat the Covenant armada.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to aim • Left Click to fire • Right Click for grenades • Space to jump • E to enter vehicles/action
games.goodToKnow: Runs fully in-browser with zero plugins. Allow pointer lock when prompted for 360-degree Spartan control.

games.title: Halo: Combat Evolved Mobile / Web (HCEMobile)
games.desc: A dedicated cross-platform client of Halo CE featuring custom mobile touch overlays, full Gamepad API integration, and customizable resolution and rendering shaders.
games.controls: Keyboard & Mouse OR Bluetooth/USB Gamepad (Xbox/PlayStation controller fully supported natively)
games.goodToKnow: Supports loading your own custom CE map files (.map) or campaign assets for complete standalone offline playback.

games.title: Skate 3 (Web Fan Project)
games.desc: Shred the plaza in Port Carverton! Recreates the fluid analog flick-it board physics and ragdoll bail mechanics of the beloved EA Skate franchise.
games.controls: Gamepad Analog Sticks Recommended • Keyboard: Arrow Keys / WASD for board manipulation & Ollies
games.goodToKnow: Plug in an Xbox or PlayStation controller for the authentic dual-stick flick-it trick experience.

games.title: Pro Evolution Soccer 6 (PES 6 Web)
games.desc: Widely celebrated as the greatest soccer simulation ever made. Master crisp one-touch passing, tactical build-up play, and unleash Adriano’s legendary 99-shot-power rockets.
games.controls: Arrow Keys for D-Pad • Z/X/C/V or A/S/D/W for Pass, Through Ball, Shoot, Sprint • Gamepad fully mapped
games.goodToKnow: Runs via in-browser PPSSPP WebAssembly. Full screen mode is highly recommended for best stadium immersion.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (reVC WASM)
games.desc: Cruise down Ocean Drive in 1986 as Tommy Vercetti. Palm trees, synthwave radio, Hawaiian shirts, and open-world chaos powered by the pristine reverse-engineered reVC engine.
games.controls: WASD to move/steer • Mouse to aim • Left Click to fire/punch • Space for handbrake/jump • F/Enter to enter vehicles
games.goodToKnow: Save files persist in browser local storage. Click canvas to capture mouse look.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto III (re3 WASM)
games.desc: The revolutionary title that introduced 3D open-world gaming. Guide Claude through the crime-ridden districts of Liberty City, steal cars, evade the LCPD, and complete underworld contracts.
games.controls: WASD to run/steer • Left Click to fire • Space to sprint/handbrake • F or Enter to jack vehicles • C to change camera
games.goodToKnow: Hosted on WASM Arcade with optimized WebGL rendering and instant browser memory allocation.

games.title: The Simpsons: Hit & Run (SHAR WASM)
games.desc: The holy grail of cartoon sandbox games. Drive around Springfield as Homer, Bart, Lisa, and Apu, smashing wasp cameras, kicking pedestrians, and uncovering the alien conspiracy.
games.controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to drive/run • Space to jump/handbrake • Left Click / E to kick • Enter to get in cars
games.goodToKnow: Pre-configured with ?skipmovie parameter for instant direct-to-menu loading. Fast and buttery smooth.

games.title: The Simpsons: Hit & Run (WASM Arcade Mirror)
games.desc: High-availability mirror of The Simpsons: Hit & Run on WASM Arcade with zero downloads, pre-cached textures, and native audio support.
games.controls: Keyboard & Gamepad supported • Standard WASD drive controls
games.goodToKnow: Alternative high-speed server if the worker endpoint is busy.

games.title: Minecraft Java 1.8.8 (Eaglercraft WASM)
games.desc: Full Minecraft Java Edition 1.8.8 running natively in your browser! Craft tools, mine diamonds, build towering castles, create survival worlds with local saves, or join online multiplayer servers.
games.controls: WASD to walk • Space to jump • Left Click to mine/attack • Right Click to place block/use • E for inventory • Q to drop
games.goodToKnow: Singleplayer worlds save automatically to your browser’s IndexedDB! Can also load custom texture packs and connect to Eaglercraft servers.

games.title: Quake (QuakeWorld Online)
games.desc: The birth of full 3D first-person shooters and multiplayer esports. Rocket jump across dark slipgates, grab the Quad Damage, and frag opponents in DM6 and DM4.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to look & fire • Space to jump (and rocket jump) • 1-8 to switch weapons • Tab for scoreboard
games.goodToKnow: Live server browser included in the menu! You can join public deathmatch matches immediately.

games.title: Quake II (JSQuake II)
games.desc: Infiltrate the Strogg home world in id Software’s industrial sci-fi sequel. Pick up the legendary Railgun, Super Shotgun, and BFG10K with smooth 120+ FPS browser rendering.
games.controls: WASD to strafe/move • Mouse aim & fire • Wheel or numbers to swap weapons • Space to jump • C to crouch
games.goodToKnow: Full multiplayer support with active dedicated servers and bot support.

games.title: Quake III Arena (ioquake3 Web)
games.desc: Welcome to the Arena Eternal. The pinnacle of pure competitive arena shooters. Jump pads, railgun flick shots, instagib mode, and iconic maps like The Longest Yard (q3dm17).
games.controls: WASD to strafe • Mouse to aim • Left Click to fire • Space to jump • Shift to walk • T for chat
games.goodToKnow: Instant-play multiplayer with active servers, low-ping WebSockets netcode, and AI bots.

games.title: Return to Castle Wolfenstein (iortcw Web)
games.desc: Fight as B.J. Blazkowicz against occult paranormal divisions and cyborg super-soldiers. Features legendary team-based objective multiplayer with Medic, Engineer, and Lieutenant classes.
games.controls: WASD to move • Left Click to shoot • Right Click to aim/alt-fire • Space to jump • C to crouch • X for prone
games.goodToKnow: Class-based objective multiplayer. Revive teammates as a Medic and dynamite objectives as an Engineer.

games.title: Urban Terror (ut.pieter.com)
games.desc: "Fun over realism!" A tactical first-person shooter combining realistic weapon ballistics with acrobatic parkour: wall jumps, power slides, stamina meters, and bandaging mechanics.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to aim/shoot • Space to jump/wall-jump • C to slide • Q for bandage bleed wounds
games.goodToKnow: Features a large initial asset download on very first visit. Once cached, boots in seconds.

games.title: Half-Life (Pixelsuft WebXash)
games.desc: Step into the hazard suit of theoretical physicist Gordon Freeman. Experience the groundbreaking scripted narrative of the Black Mesa Resonance Cascade and fight back against the HECU military.
games.controls: WASD to walk • Mouse look & fire • E to use/open doors • Space to jump • Ctrl to crouch • F for flashlight
games.goodToKnow: Pre-loaded with the official demo/hazard course! You can also drag-and-drop your own Half-Life steam assets to play the full campaign.

games.title: Counter-Strike 1.6 & Half-Life (webXash)
games.desc: The definitive competitive tactical shooter. Terrorists vs. Counter-Terrorists in de_dust2, cs_assault, and cs_office running inside modern WebAssembly.
games.controls: WASD to move • Left Click to shoot • Right Click for silencer/zoom • B to buy menu • E to defuse/plant
games.goodToKnow: WebXash supports custom mods, localized save files, and direct zip asset loading from your local disk.

games.title: Diablo 1 (DiabloWeb / DevilutionX)
games.desc: The dark gothic action RPG that started it all. Choose Warrior, Rogue, or Sorcerer, descend through 16 randomly generated dungeon levels beneath Tristram, and defeat Diablo.
games.controls: Left Click to move & attack • Right Click to cast spell • Shift + Click to attack in place • I for inventory • C for stats
games.goodToKnow: Pre-loaded with the shareware demo! If you have the original game, simply drop your DIABDAT.MPQ into the window to play the full game with saving!

excluded.name: Modern Warfare 2 (Railway)
excluded.reason: Server responds with HTTP 429 / Cloudflare automated bot-check ("Checking your browser"). Unreachable directly for interactive play.

excluded.name: Skate Rust
excluded.reason: Commercial streetwear store & horror lore merchandise website. Does not host a playable game client.

excluded.name: GTA 5 (Wayback Machine)
excluded.reason: Truncated URL string in prompt. Resolves only to the general Internet Archive home page.

excluded.name: Hedgewars (Webwars)
excluded.reason: Server crashes with Django DisallowedHost (400 Bad Request) due to misconfigured ALLOWED_HOSTS setting.
